title: Don’t miss this experience of the Nasrid Palaces with Juan - spectacular!
text:
Juan and his evening tour was nothing short of fabulous! He went to every length to ensure we were able to join his tour at the last minute, and it was amazing. The night tour is a peaceful experience, with small groups and respectfully quiet in the Palaces. Juan easily switches between Spanish and English to cater for our little group and we went at a leisurely pace not feeling at all rushed. He is incredibly knowledgeable and respectful of the history, as well as having a great sense of humour.
Thank you again Juan, our 4 hour day tour you managed to book us in to was brilliant also!
author: AmyRoberts13
